periods.label: Mon 21 Sep
periods.text: West to northwesterly 15 to 20 knots shifting southerly 15 to 25 knots in the early morning. Winds reaching up to 30 knots during the day. Squalls possible with the early morning wind change. 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning. Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning. Partly cloudy.
